{
  "subtype": "predictive_feature_engineering",
  "focus_variable": "inefficient_resolution",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "incident_category", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Derived from short_description, known at open time; category (e.g., hardware vs software) plausibly correlates with resolution efficiency and lies outside the focus."},
    {"name": "failure_type", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Nature of failure (physical damage, connectivity, performance) is knowable up front and plausibly predicts how hard/long resolution will be; not a restatement of the outcome."},
    {"name": "affected_device_type", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Device type is available early and can carry signal about resolution complexity; independent of the efficiency outcome."},
    {"name": "assignee_is_resolver", "role": "leakage", "is_predictor": false, "rationale": "Whether the assignee ended up being the resolver reflects reassignment/hand-off behavior that unfolds during the resolution process; it is only known at/after closure and is intertwined with efficiency itself, so it leaks the outcome."},
    {"name": "repeat_incident_signal", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Whether the incident/caller appears to be recurring is knowable independently of this incident's outcome and plausibly predicts inefficiency; a legitimate predictor."},
    {"name": "description_specificity", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Specificity of the report text is available at open time and vague descriptions plausibly correlate with slower/inefficient handling; outside the focus."},
    {"name": "requires_physical_action", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Whether a physical intervention is needed is inferable up front and plausibly drives longer resolution paths; independent predictive signal."},
    {"name": "opened_day_of_week", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Temporal context known at open time; weekend/weekday effects on staffing can plausibly influence efficiency. Weak but legitimate, non-leaking predictor."}
  ],
  "n_predictors": 7,
  "predictive_utility": 0.55,
  "rationale": "Most added columns are legitimate, early-knowable predictors capturing incident nature, device, recurrence, report quality, physical-action need, and timing—collectively giving a model meaningful leverage beyond the raw fields. However several (incident_category, affected_device_type, failure_type, requires_physical_action) are correlated re-encodings of the same short_description signal, so their marginal information overlaps. assignee_is_resolver is leakage because resolver-vs-assignee status reflects hand-offs occurring during resolution and is entangled with the efficiency outcome. Net: solid but partially redundant predictive value."
}
